title: evals-baseline baseline file, specification 1.0
description: The shape of the evals-baseline.json file that evals-baseline specification 1.0 defines. A schema checks shape only. The specification decides what a schema cannot say: that recordedAt names a day that exists, that no key appears twice in one object, and that the metric keys are in sorted order.

spec.description: The specification version the file follows, written MAJOR.MINOR. A reader of version 1.0 reads a file of major 1 and minor 0 or older, which is this value alone.

recordedAt.description: An ISO 8601 UTC time to the millisecond, the only clock in the file. This pattern checks the form. A day that does not exist, such as 2026-02-30, passes the pattern and is still not a time.

metrics.description: One entry per metric, keyed by the metric key of its tool. A baseline that names no metric guards nothing, so at least one is required.

toolVersion.description: The version string the tool wrote into its own output, or null when the output carries none.
The version string the tool wrote into its own output, or null when the output carries none. DeepEval's output carries none.

count.description: The number of cases in the run.

digest.description: The first 12 hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 that the binding check defines, in lowercase.

value.description: The mean of the metric's samples, on the tool's own scale, rounded to 6 decimals. A reader refuses a value whose size is more than 4000000000.

samples.description: The sample count, a positive integer.

tolerance.description: The absolute tolerance, a number from 0 to 4000000000, in the metric's own units.
